scope: Inline checked CPU arithmetic, unary signs, reduceSum and matmul in mixed CPU/GPU source main; nested CPU, transfer and GPU scalar arguments.

semantics.placement: Inline expressions use completed host values. Device tensors require explicit download; pending tasks require explicit observation. No automatic GPU placement or implicit transfer.
semantics.arithmetic: Existing strict float32 rules, complete-axis elementwise equality, scalar lifting, exact unary sign behavior, fixed-tree reductions and separately rounded matmul products.
semantics.typing: Private wrappers use compiler-owned operator/type spellings and the common checker. Imported functions/symbols/values/dynamic extents receive fresh IDs and original source spans.
semantics.evaluation: Operands evaluate in source order before acquiring references into growable typed arenas. GPU entry metadata is copied before nested argument compilation.
semantics.cache: One private checked kernel per operation and operand-rank signature. User function names cannot collide with generated names.
semantics.shapes: Inline outputs retain known axes derived from input shapes; unknown shape obligations are checked before CPU descriptor export or arithmetic.
semantics.ownership: Existing checked invocation/C-interface export/import and result leases; no CPU-copy removal, tensor-chain fusion or runtime layout changes.
semantics.limits: Current float32 scalar/rank-one/rank-two mixed source subset. Shared placement-aware task IR, mixed CPU spawn, richer control flow and broader types remain open.

coverage: Inline scalar arguments compiled while a GPU call is being checked
Byte budget, cancellation, group deadline and failed completion

cli.dynamic_fault: Hidden matmul dimensions compile, then raise shape fault with 1/2/4 workers before element access.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Source composition and correctness work; no performance claim.
